design_detail: Exit tax on emigrating high-net-worth individuals to prevent tax avoidance on accumulated domestic and offshore assets
quote_original: 陈晶莹提出，建议加强富豪移民海外的税收清算和开征弃籍税。
quote_en: Chen Jingying proposed strengthening tax clearance for wealthy emigrants overseas and introducing an exit tax.
source_title: 全国人大代表：部分富豪移民逃税后仍在国内赚钱 建议开征弃籍税
grading_note: Grade A: formal legislative proposal submitted by an NPC deputy during the March 2022 National People's Congress session

design_detail: Introduction of property and inheritance taxes as part of state secondary distribution
quote_original: 我赞成开征财产税和遗产税，但目的不能定位于逼富人捐助。第一，政府征税属于再分配，并不是三次分配；
quote_en: I support introducing a property/wealth tax and an inheritance tax, but the objective must not be defined as forcing the rich to donate. First, government taxation belongs to redistribution, not tertiary distribution;
source_title: 王东京：“三次分配”的制度安排
grading_note: Grade B: explicit named support for introducing a property/wealth tax by an NPC Standing Committee member and economist

design_detail: Exit tax (弃籍税) and asset exit levy (资产离境税) on emigrating capital and high-net-worth individuals
quote_original: 未来我国应积极探索建立弃籍税制度,抑制资产外流。同时,要尽可能地设立资产离境税,即针对“逃离”国内的资本进行征税:一方面,防止资本外逃,使得资本能够长期在国内进行有效的流通和循环
quote_en: In the future, our country should actively explore establishing an exit tax system to curb asset outflow. At the same time, we should set up an asset exit tax as far as possible, namely taxing capital that 'flees' the country: on the one hand, preventing capital flight so that capital can circulate and cycle domestically in the long term
source_title: 程恩富 叶道良：怎样缩小我国财富和收入分配差距？
grading_note: Grade A: specific academic policy proposal detailing both exit tax and asset exit levy mechanisms to prevent capital flight

design_detail: 2% minimum wealth tax on billionaires and national net wealth tax base assessment
quote_original: 在完善财产税的税制体系同时，积累财富税或最低财富税征收管理经验，实现对财富的有效调节。
quote_en: While improving the property tax system, accumulate experience in the collection and administration of wealth tax or minimum wealth tax, to achieve effective regulation of wealth.
source_title: 全球最低财富税发展脉络及中国应对措施
publisher: 《财政科学》 / 中国人民大学财税研究所

design_detail: UN and G20 coordinated wealth tax on billionaires
quote_original: 财富税（wealthtax）不同于所得税（income tax）。所得税是对财富的流量征税，即纳税人每年赚了多少，而财富税是对存量征税，关注纳税人此刻拥有多少净资产。
quote_en: Wealth tax differs from income tax. Income tax taxes wealth flows, that is how much a taxpayer earns each year, while wealth tax taxes stocks, focusing on how much net assets a taxpayer possesses at this moment.
source_title: 向全球亿万富翁征税，联合国能做到吗
grading_note: Grade B: think-tank op-ed analyzing the mechanics and necessity of international wealth taxation and billionaire minimum tax coordination
